title: 第一卷 第12章 被压着打第一卷 第13章 掌教出山
slug: 百倍返还我家孽徒全是女帝转世
content_zh:
王肖恭恭敬敬地垂手站在一旁着，好奇地打量林枫，如同看什么神仙一般，十分仰慕。
同是他心里又隐隐觉得有些不安，黑石帮盘踞清溪镇多年，总觉得他们背后的靠山不简单。
半个时辰的时限转瞬即逝。
可巷口空空荡荡，别说黑石帮老大，就连先前报信的两个混混，也彻底没了踪影。
林枫眉梢微挑，眸底掠过一丝冷意。
就在此刻。
咻——！
尖锐刺耳的破风声骤然撕裂长街静谧！
浓郁厚重的筑基灵力，宛如狂风巨浪，骤然从高空碾压而下！
整条小巷的碎石、尘土尽数腾空，气流狂暴肆虐，压得人呼吸一滞。
“不知死活的东西，也敢动我青岚世家的人？”
一道倨傲冷厉的少年声响自云层落下。
青衫猎猎作响，一名二十出头的修士踏空而立，悬于巷口高空。
男子面容桀骜，眉眼带着常年身居高位的傲慢，腰间挂着一枚刻着岚纹的青玉腰牌。
青岚世家是大楚老牌修仙世家，扎根清溪镇百年不倒，族中有金丹老祖坐镇，势力根深蒂固。
李青玄目光轻蔑，死死锁定巷中白衣的林枫。
空中威压滚滚沉降，实打实的筑基境灵力锁死整片小巷。
林枫抬眸，白衣临风，神色依旧淡然。
“青岚世家？”
他心中瞬间了然始末。

难怪一群凡人混混有恃无恐，原来是背靠本土修仙世家，仗势横行、欺压乡邻。
李青玄见他不语，只当他害怕了，笑意愈发阴冷：
“要么自废三层修为，跪地赔罪。”
“要么，今日我废你全身经脉，押你回青岚家府请罪！”
话音未落，李青玄眼底凶光骤盛！
“青岚刃杀术！”
轰！
半空狂风骤起，空中出现一个巨大的镖状利刃，而后又分裂出无数个利刃。
每一道利刃都裹挟筑基四层的凌厉劲力，切割空气发出刺耳嘶鸣。
这是青岚世家传承的本命术法，杀伐极强，专门用来碾压同阶、镇杀低修！
王肖瞳孔骤缩，大气都不敢出，一颗心瞬间悬到了嗓子眼。
面对这般强劲的攻势，林枫脚下步伐倏然虚化。
白衣身影如同风中虚影，身姿缥缈不定，明明就在原地，却偏偏让所有利刃全部落空！
密密麻麻的剽状利刃狠狠砸在巷壁青石之上。
砰砰砰砰砰！
高空的李青玄脸色骤然一沉，眼底满是惊愕。
“天阶身法？！”
他难以置信！
不等他回神，林枫身形已然借着利刃间隙，凌空而起，直逼高空。
“速度倒是挺快，可惜——没用！”

李青玄惊怒交加，果断压下震撼，双手飞速结印！
周身青色灵力暴涨三倍，身前凝聚出一面厚重的青岚灵盾，固若金汤。
接着又打出一道掌风，掌风裹挟狂风，重力滔天，欲要一掌镇压林枫！
两大筑基修士半空交锋，灵力对冲炸开滚滚气浪，震得整条长街狂风呼啸！
轰隆！
content_en:
Wang Xiao stood aside with his hands lowered respectfully, looking at Lin Feng curiously, as if he were looking at a god, admiring him very much.
At the same time, he felt a little uneasy in his heart. The Blackstone Gang had been entrenched in Qingxi Town for many years, and he always felt that the backers behind them were not simple.
The half-hour time limit flies by.
But the alley was empty. Not to mention the boss of the Blackstone Gang, even the two gangsters who reported the news before were completely missing.
Lin Feng raised his eyebrows slightly, and there was a hint of coldness in his eyes.
Right now.
call out--!
The sharp and harsh sound of breaking wind suddenly tore apart the silence of the long street!
The rich and thick foundation-building spiritual power was like a strong wind and huge waves, suddenly crushing down from high altitude!
The entire alleyway was filled with gravel and dust, and the air flow was so violent that it made people's breath suffocate.
"Those who don't know life or death dare to touch members of my Qinglan family?"
An arrogant and cold young man's voice fell from the clouds.
The green shirt made a sound, and a monk in his early twenties stood up in the air, hanging high in the alley.
The man has an unruly face, his eyebrows are arrogant as he has always been in a high position, and around his waist hangs a sapphire waistband engraved with a haze pattern.
The Qinglan family is a long-established immortal cultivating family in Dachu. It has taken root in Qingxi Town and has not failed for a hundred years. The Jindan ancestor is in the family, and its power is deeply rooted.
Li Qingxuan's eyes were contemptuous, and he locked eyes on Lin Feng, who was dressed in white in the alley.
The pressure in the air settled, and the solid foundation-building spiritual power locked the entire alley.
Lin Feng raised his eyes, his white clothes facing the wind, his expression still calm.
"Qinglan family?"
He instantly understood the whole story.
No wonder a group of mortal gangsters were so confident. It turned out that they were relying on a local family of immortal cultivators to run rampant and oppress their neighbors.
When Li Qingxuan saw him silent, he just thought he was scared, and his smile became colder:
"Either you deprive yourself of the third level of cultivation and kneel down to apologize."
"Or, today I will destroy all your meridians and take you back to Qinglan's house to plead guilty!"
Before he finished speaking, Li Qingxuan's eyes suddenly became fierce!
"Qinglan Blade Killing Technique!"
Boom!
A violent wind suddenly rose in mid-air, and a huge dart-shaped blade appeared in the air, and then split into countless blades.
Each sharp blade carries the fierce power of the fourth level of the foundation, cutting the air with a harsh hiss.
This is the natal magic passed down by the Qinglan family. It is extremely lethal and is specially used to crush people of the same level and suppress lower cultivators!
Wang Xiao's pupils shrank suddenly, he didn't dare to breathe out, and his heart suddenly reached his throat.
Facing such a powerful offensive, Lin Feng's steps suddenly became blurry.
The white-clothed figure was like a shadow in the wind, its figure was ethereal and uncertain. It was obviously where it was, but all the sharp blades failed!
The densely packed razor-shaped blades hit the bluestone on the alley wall hard.
Bang bang bang bang bang!
Li Qingxuan's face suddenly darkened at high altitude, and his eyes were filled with astonishment.
"Heaven-level movement skills?!"
He couldn't believe it!
Before he could recover, Lin Feng's figure had already taken advantage of the gap between the sharp blades and soared into the sky, reaching high in the sky.
"It's quite fast, but it's a pity - it's useless!"
Li Qingxuan was shocked and angry. He suppressed the shock decisively and quickly formed seals with his hands!
The green spiritual energy around him surged three times, and a thick Qinglan spiritual shield condensed in front of him, which was impregnable.
Then he fired another palm wind. The palm wind was carrying a strong wind, and the gravity was so strong that he wanted to suppress Lin Feng with one palm!
The two foundation-building monks clashed in mid-air, and the clash of spiritual powers exploded into billowing air waves, making the entire street howl with violent winds!
Boom!
